notes.title: 12 years after launch, this GTA style crime game just got a surprise update
notes.content:
Whenever I see that an old game has received a surprise update out of the blue, it immediately gets my attention. Is it preparing for some kind of revival or unexpected new content? Did a huge bug get uncovered after all these years? Is it preparing to be in a huge sale or bundle? Whatever the reason ends up being, it's hard not to pique my interest when this situation arises - a situation that GTA-style crime game Retro City Rampage DX just found itself in.

Read the rest of the story...

Retro City Rampage video shows making of the NES version
Game Music Bundle 4 is worth buying for Jessica Curry's Dear Esther score alone

notes.title: Retro City Rampage DX - Update v2.10
notes.content:
It's been over twelve years since Retro City Rampage originally released, and I'm excited to announce that a new update is now available for PC, Mac, and Linux.

This quality-of-life update addresses various bugs, compatibility, and performance issues [i](many reported by you, thank you!)[/i].

[h1]v2.10 CHANGES | 2024/11/14[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]New Audio Engine (Windows)[/b]
[list][*]Replaced DirectSound with XAudio2 for improved performance and compatibility.[/list]
[*][b]DirectX Renderer (Windows)[/b]
[list][*]Fixed re-initialization errors that could occur when switching modes.[/list]
[*][b]Leaderboards[/b]
[list][*]If leaderboards appear to be unavailable [i](ie. if you're offline)[/i], the game will no longer continuously attempt to read them. This should improve performance when playing offline.[/list]
[*][b]Button Icons[/b]
[list][*]Although the game auto-detects most popular game controllers, you can now manually choose a specific button icon style [i](PlayStation or Xbox style icons)[/i] from the menu.[/list]
[*][b]More Controller Support[/b]
[list]
[*]PS5 controllers are now automatically detected and no longer need to be calibrated.
[*]Added support for more game controllers on macOS and Linux.
[/list]
[*][b]Overscan Mode[/b]
[list][*]The overscan setting is now saved to settings, so you no longer need to set it each time you launch the game.[/list]
[*][b]Apple M1+ Support (macOS)[/b]
[list]
[*]Now built for Apple Silicon [i](as well as Intel)[/i].
[*]Fixed an issue where the game could run too fast on newer machines.
[*]Fixed an issue where audio may not work correctly on newer machines.
[/list]
[*][b]Steamworks Upgraded[/b]
[list][*]Upgraded the Steam versions to the latest Steamworks SDK[/list]
[*][b]Misc. Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Most importantly, it fixes an issue caused by collecting weapon truck keys during some missions expecting a different key.[/list]
[/list]
Thank you so much for playing! I hope you enjoy the new update.
[i]-Brian, Developer of Retro City Rampage[/i]

notes.title: NOW AVAILABLE: LINUX + MS-DOS, plus bonus Windows 3.1 Prototype!
notes.content:
Retro City Rampage 486 for MS-DOS is out NOW, along with a (surprise!) LINUX version of RCR:DX and the Windows 3.1 prototype, free for all of you who already own RCR on PC+MAC.

The Boxed Collector's Edition on 3.5" Floppy Disk is also available for $29.99 ($14.99 for floppy only) while supplies last.

Full Scoop & Trailer:
http://retrocityrampage.com/msdos_retail.php


To Get Retro City Rampage for MS-DOS on Steam:
1. Update the game (if you don't see an update, restart Steam)
2. In Steam, go to Retro City Rampage DX's "Properties"
3. Click "Local Files" -> "Browse Local Files"
4. Open RetroCityRampage486_MS-DOS_v1.0.zip

For Humble Store or GOG, login and download the appropriate .zip file.


If you don't have an old PC running DOS, RCR:486 works great under DOSBox.

You can also run DOS and RCR:486 on modern PCs by creating a DOS bootable 
USB flash drive, CD or DVD.

notes.title: 1.51 Update released, Live Twitch Q&A/Stream right now!
notes.content:

• Alternate keys

notes.title: 'DX' update and Mac OS version, AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
The new free 'DX' update and Mac OS X version are ready to download and play!

Watch the "Retro City Rampage™ DX - What's New in 'DX'?" Trailer
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JuVrtMQUBxw

Below are some (but not nearly all) of the changes. It's a huge one!

[h1]#### v1.50 CHANGES | 2014/11/11 ####[/h1]

• [b]'DX' VERSION[/b]
- Includes top to bottom remastered 'DX' mode

- New 'DX' leaderboards

• [b]MAC OS X[/b]
- Mac version added

• [b]STEAM CLOUD[/b]

• [b]WEAPON TRUCKS[/b]
- Hijack or buy weapons around the city

• [b]NEW COP SYSTEM[/b]
- Clear the screen to lose the cops

- Interactive map with waypoints

• [b]NEW HUD[/b]
- Choose the new overlay hud, or old status bar

• [b]NEW ZOOM MODES[/b]
- 1X, 2X or 3X

• [b]WEAPON SELECT MENU[/b]
- Select weapons from a grid

• [b]NEW BORDERS & VIDEO OPTIONS[/b]
- Widescreen tube border
- BG brightness slider
- 8-BIT/RETRO+ modes improved

• [b]SPANISH TRANSLATION[/b]
- New Spanish translation

notes.title: Free major 'DX' Update & Mac OS X version, NEXT WEEK!
notes.content:
Over two years after the initial release, the post launch support continues!

Retro City Rampage's 'DX' version which debuted on Nintendo 3DS earlier this year is coming to PC as a free update, along with more HD bells and whistles. New zoom modes, video options, new 'DX' Leaderboards, and much much more!

Additionally, it's coming to Mac OS X!

Both the major update and Mac version will be free to everyone who owns the game already or purchases it in the future. Specifically, like all Steam games, the Mac version will be available for free to all who purchase or have purchased the PC version, and the PC version for all who purchase the Mac version.

For the full scoop, read this:
http://retrocityrampage.com/press/RetroCityRampageDX_20141103.pdf

And watch this:
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JuVrtMQUBxw


Thanks for all of the support and for enjoying Retro City Rampage!

Stay tuned for more details!

notes.title: Retro City Rampage v1.16 Released
notes.content:
Another big update. Lots of changes/tweaks. The upcoming 3DS version's received a lot of updates, so the PC version gets them too! More to come still!


[h1]#### v1.16 CHANGES | 2014/01/23 ####[/h1]

• [b]EFFECTS[/b]
- Added more Retro+ visual enhancements. Weapon/attack/vehicle/character effects added, including rocket smoke trails and more. Certain weapons and vehicles now have more "oomph!".

• [b]JUMPING[/b]
- You can now jump while in the middle of shooting or attacking and no longer need to wait until the attack has completed.

• [b]TV COLOR MODES[/b]
- 7 new TV color modes added! Check them out!

• [b]KEYS[/b]
- For WASD players, E can now be pressed to enter vehicles, V can be pressed to pick up objects.

• [b]SHADOWS[/b]
- Sprite shadows now appear over background shadows for more contrast.

• [b]SWEAT TIME[/b]
- Checkpoints added.

• [b]RETICLE[/b]
- New reticle on targeted characters/objects.

• [b]FRAME LIMITER[/b]
- Game now runs at the correct speed on all machines when using vsync.

• [b]RENDERER[/b]
- DirectX swapchain updated for smoother graphics.

• [b]MISC TWEAKS[/b]
- Too many to list!

notes.title: Retro City Rampage v1.15 Released
notes.content:
[h1]#### v1.15 CHANGES | 2013/12/14 ####[/h1]

New update! It's a big one. In addition to some little tweaks and improvements brought over from the upcoming 3DS version, it boasts a bunch of PC specific additions! Let me know what you think.

• [b]MOUSE SUPPORT[/b]
- Aiming and shooting can now be done with the mouse. Enable under the controls menu.
- Provides free aiming with a soft lock-on to amp up the accuracy.
- Weapon select and menu selection as well. 

• [b]WASD MODE[/b]
- A third key mode has been added which maps both WASD and the Arrow Keys to movement simultaneously. Enable under the controls menu.

• [b]QUIT CONFIRMATION[/b]
- To avoid accidential lost progress when failing a mission, the game will now require confirmation if you choose not to retry the mission.

• [b]AUDIO[/b]
- If there's a problem with the sound driver, the game will now display an error message and continue to work correctly (minus audio) instead of crashing.

• [b]FRAMERATE[/b]
- Added manual framerate/vsync options to the settings menu. 
- You can now turn on/off vsync and switch between 30/60 fps.

• [b]ENEMY BLIPS[/b]
- Enemies and police now appear on the minimap on the top left of the status bar.

• [b]MONSTER TRUCK[/b]
- Now animates!

• [b]CHANGES[/b]
- This change list can now be viewed from within the game via the Main Menu.
